chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Haywood Henry's hello and gratitude to the men
summary: Haywood sent his regards and Hawkins is grateful.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Cause one of the things very evident, as soon as I mentioned to Haywood, for example, you know, well I have to go up and interview Erskine. You know, he says ah, tell him I said hello. I mean that's the first thing he wants to be sure that you do. And, I get that kind of warm response from people whenever you mention that regard. And that must feel good.
Yeah, I'm going by to see him soon as I can cause I know where he is now. You know, in Ain't Misbehavin'.

Cause he went down to you, he went down to Birmingham with me just a little bit before. He went in for a week, and then he went down to do this concert and come back. Cause, he had been with Sy for quite awhile, didn't he?
Right. And then, you know, a few years back, you know, when he left the studios to go out with Earl Hines.
Oh, that's right, too. I forgot about that.
Yeah. That's, that was when he, you know, stopped doing a lot of studio work to go out on the road, you know, with Earl Hines. That was years back though. That was back in the 60's, wasn't it?

Well, I don't know what I'd have done without those boys. I'm glad things did turn out like it did. You know, I don't know what would have happened to me if I'd have been working with someone else, you know, through the years. But, they made it real comfortable for me.
